reason: Reviewer (Baird, 2026-09-22) spotted that IMO 1019670 now carries a name. Shipspotting's vessel page for the IMO titles it CHRISTY VANGUARD and is the only source carrying it: IGU 2025 and 2026 both print 'Hull 2663' for the IMO, shipvault unit 463995 still reads 'MT HULL 2663', and marinetraffic.org reads 'SAMSUNG 2663'. The name fits MOL's '<X>y Vanguard' series exactly, including the sister hull of this same duo (live row 875, IMO 1019668, Hull 2662 (SHI) -> Gamy Vanguard) plus live rows 847 (Archy Vanguard) and 960 (Barthy Vanguard) -- all three named off shipvault, which has simply not yet renamed unit 463995. Single non-primary source with the value verbatim and entity-level confirmation -> Yellow (SOP 5). Status stays 'on order': shipspotting categorises the vessel 'Ships Under Construction' and shipvault schedules delivery 2027-01, so this is a naming, not a delivery.
